private_note: I can't put any odds on where I'll land, and the result lasts a generation with no second chance, so I'm judging each plan by its worst case. Hazel gives the bottom group the most, at 41. Birch comes next with 36, then Alder with 32, then Today with 22. Cedar's floor of 15 is the worst of all, so I'd rather the convention fail than adopt it. I could move to Birch or Alder if Hazel can't reach 9 votes.
statement: Delegates, none of us knows which fifth we will wake up in. We can't even guess the odds, and whatever we choose will bind us for a generation. With that much at stake, I don't think it makes sense to gamble on the top. I'm asking each of you: what is the worst this plan could do to my own household? Under Cedar the worst case is 15 thousand with no health coverage, which is worse than today. Under Hazel it is 41 thousand, the highest floor any plan offers. Hazel's average is lower, but we will be living in one particular group, not in the average. I rank Hazel first, then Birch, which is also strong and the fairest in spread, then Alder. Every one of them beats today's floor. We need nine votes, so let's find out which high-floor plan we can rally behind instead of letting the convention fail.
